description_en: Batch deletes domain name configurations by calling BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs
description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs批量删除域名配置
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn batch-delete-dcdn-domain-configs --domain-names example.com --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names for which you want to delete configurations. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:
The product of the number of domain names and the number of functions must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If 20 functions are configured at a time, only 1 domain name can be specified.
If 1 function is configured at a time, up to 20 domain names can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en:
The names of the feature functions that you want to delete. Separate multiple function names with commas (,). Note the following limits:
The product of the number of domain names and the number of functions must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If 20 functions are configured at a time, only 1 domain name can be specified.
If 1 function is configured at a time, up to 20 domain names can be specified.

For more information about function names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名。

更多功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html
parameters.name: function_names
